initialize_result.instructions:
DevExpress MCP server provides accurate and up-to-date information about DevExpress products.

## Workflow

Use this workflow to query DevExpress documentation content:

1. Call `devexpress_docs_search(technologies, question)`. The response contains results with valid 'url' fields.
2. Pick a result and call `devexpress_docs_get_content(url)` with that exact URL to fetch the complete markdown text.
3. Repeat steps 1 and 2 as needed to gather more information.

IMPORTANT:
- Always call `devexpress_docs_search` before `devexpress_docs_get_content` to obtain documentation URLs.
- Never construct URLs using your general knowledge; use documentation URLs from the search response.
- You can pass multiple technologies to broaden the search, if needed.
- You must strictly follow the list of allowed technologies: Angular, AspNet, AspNetBootstrap, AspNetCore, AspNetMvc, ASPxThemeBuilder, ASPxThemeDeployer, Blazor, CodedUIExtension, CoreLibraries, Dashboard, DesignSystem, DevExtremeAspNetMvc, eud, eXpressAppFramework, GeneralInformation, jQuery, MAUI, OfficeFileAPI, OfficeFileApiJava, React, ReportServer, SkinEditor, VCL, Vue, WindowsForms, WPF, WpfThemeDesigner, XPO, XpoProfiler, XtraReports.

tools.description:
Search DevExpress documentation for a given technology and a question.
If you want to search for multiple technologies, pass them as a list.
This tool returns only snippets/excerpts; full content requires a follow-up `devexpress_docs_get_content` call on a chosen URL.
ALWAYS call `devexpress_docs_search` before ANY `devexpress_docs_get_content` call in a user request chain.

technologies.description:
List of DevExpress technologies to search within.
Use specific technology names like 'WindowsForms', 'XtraReports', 'OfficeFileAPI' etc. You must choose from the allowed set.
technologies.title: Technologies

question.description:
Your specific question, phrased in natural language.
Describe what you're trying to accomplish and name the relevant controls, APIs, or features.
This tool performs semantic search using a text embedding model, so the query must be semantically meaningful.
question.title: Question

tools.name: devexpress_docs_search
tools.title: Search DevExpress Documentation

tools.description:
Get full document content by URL from DevExpress documentation.
Use this tool to retrieve the complete markdown content of a specific documentation page.
PREREQUISITE: ALWAYS call `devexpress_docs_search` before using this tool to get valid URLs.
The URL parameter must be obtained from the results of the `devexpress_docs_search` tool.

url.description:
Full URL of a DevExpress documentation article.
REQUIRED: This URL must be obtained from a previous call to `devexpress_docs_search` tool.
Do not construct URLs using your general knowledge.
Example: https://docs.devexpress.com/CoreLibraries/405204
url.title: Url

tools.name: devexpress_docs_get_content
tools.title: Get DevExpress Documentation Content
